targets.expr: sum by (coolify_resource) (count_over_time({coolify_project="global-valura-dev", host="dev-server-1", coolify_resource=~"$resource", container=~"$container", level=~"$level"} |~ "(?i)$search" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Errors & warnings
panels.description: error / warn / fatal lines from the selected services. $search is an optional regex line filter.

panels.title: Live tail  —  all logs
panels.description: Every line from the selected $resource / $container, filtered by $level and $search. Newest first.

options.content: **Traces are wired but empty until the apps emit spans.** On each Coolify service set `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://10.200.2.51:4318`, `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=<name>`, `OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=otlp`. Flow: `app → Alloy(.51) → OTel Collector(.52) → Jaeger`; RED metrics (`traces_spanmetrics_*`) are derived automatically. See [docs/dev-dashboards.md].

panels.title: Recent traces  ($service)
panels.description: Jaeger search. Choose $service once spans arrive.
